question: Can decision-time observable features reliably identify regimes in which selecting a specialist policy improves the final decision enough to justify routing?

headline: RESOURCE_PRESERVING_V1
NEXUS_SELECTOR
OBJECTIVE_TARGETING_V1
THREAT_COVERING_V1

diagnosticOnly.CANDIDATE_ROUTER: the same methodology with NEXUS_SELECTOR_V2_CANDIDATE in the NEXUS slot; reported separately, never headline (P.1E: SHORTCUT_DEPENDENT)

policySet.choicesSource: the stored corpus choices, which Stage 3F.6-P.1E reproduced 20000/20000; fresh partitions store them the same way

rules.NON_DEPLOYABLE: contract decisionTimeAvailable is false, or a SIMULATOR_* / EXPERT_V2B capability is required
rules.LEAKED: contract labelDerived is true, OR (empirical) single-feature DEV AUROC >= 0.99 for any regime target or best-policy target
rules.REQUIRES_ORACLE: the feature is computed from counterfactual outcomes (none of the contract evidence paths may reference the oracle)
rules.DIVERGENT: the stored feature differs from its value on any D4 twin on the corpus equivariance sample (P.1D flag) or on the fresh sample
rules.UNAVAILABLE: the feature is missing or non-finite on any row

featureAudit.headlineRule: the headline router uses DEPLOYABLE features only; a feature failing the audit is reported and dropped, never silently replaced

partitions.CAL: selection (router threshold, regime thresholds, best single, cascade order)
partitions.FRESH_HOLDOUT: PRIMARY confirmatory: 6000 new records from the declared, unused HOLDOUT seed 2022 (curriculum levels 0-5 in canonical order)
partitions.FRESH_OOD: PRIMARY robustness: 6000 new records from the declared, unused OOD seed 2032 (levels 6-7)
partitions.EXPOSED_HOLDOUT: SECONDARY: the P.1D/P.1E HOLDOUT; its policy outcomes were fully evaluated by P.1E and the costly-action hypothesis was formed on it
partitions.EXPOSED_OOD: SECONDARY: the P.1D/P.1E OOD, likewise exposed
partitions.exposureDecision: mirrors the historical Stage 3F.6-T decision: exposed partitions are not used for primary claims
partitions.freshAdmission: P.1D corpusRecord (unchanged, benchmark-bound) in canonical combination order; a candidate whose record, world or topology hash is already claimed anywhere in the 20000-row lineage or earlier in the fresh set is rejected; equivariance sampled every 25th combination
partitions.freshGeneration: only after this plan and the open-phase report are committed unchanged at HEAD

methodology.confidenceRule: ON CAL: minimise mean regret; ties -> higher task accuracy -> lower threshold (higher coverage)

router.bestSingle: deployable policy with coverage 1 on DEV+CAL and minimum mean regret (historical rule)
router.threshold: historical CAL rule over the historical grid: minimise mean regret; ties -> higher accuracy -> lower threshold
router.complexity: no larger model; no deep network; no world model; no non-deployable feature

definitions.COSTLY_ACTION_OPTIMAL: no optimal action has declared cost 0 (P.1E definition); RESOURCE, which always selects a zero-cost action, is then necessarily wrong
definitions.FREE_ACTION_OPTIMAL: complement of COSTLY_ACTION_OPTIMAL; reported for completeness, identical discrimination by construction
definitions.NEXUS_V1_BEATS_RESOURCE: NEXUS V1 proposes and its regret is strictly below RESOURCE (evaluated on V1-proposing rows)
definitions.OBJECTIVE_APPLICABLE: OBJECTIVE proposes and its regret is strictly below RESOURCE (evaluated on OBJECTIVE-proposing rows)
definitions.THREAT_APPLICABLE: THREAT proposes and its regret is strictly below RESOURCE (evaluated on THREAT-proposing rows)

regimeTargets.oracleOnly: every target is oracle-derived; targets are never router inputs
regimeTargets.model: binary logistic regression with the Stage 3F.6-T optimiser settings (DEV standardisation, zeros init, lr 0.1, l2 1e-3 excl. bias, 2000 full-batch iterations), fitted on DEV
metrics: Brier score and Brier skill vs DEV base rate
precision / recall / F1 at the CAL threshold that maximises F1 on a 0.01 grid (ties -> lower threshold)
regimeTargets.minPositives: a target with fewer than 50 positives in DEV or in the evaluated partition is reported INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for that partition
regimeTargets.identifiable: REGIME_IDENTIFIABLE when FRESH_HOLDOUT AUROC >= 0.75; WEAKLY_IDENTIFIABLE when >= 0.65; else NOT_IDENTIFIABLE

baselines.RANDOM_VALID_POLICY: uniform over proposing headline policies, reported as exact expectation
baselines.FIXED_PRIORITY_CASCADE_P1E: the P.1E frozen cascade THREAT -> OBJECTIVE -> NEXUS_V2 -> RESOURCE (includes the diagnostic V2)
baselines.FIXED_PRIORITY_CASCADE_HEADLINE: the same CAL rule restricted to headline specialists: those whose CAL accuracy-when-proposing exceeds the best single, in descending CAL accuracy, then the best single
baselines.HISTORICAL_3F6T_ROUTER_FROZEN: the historical Stage 3F.6-T router weights (trained on Forge V1), applied unchanged at their frozen threshold and fallback
baselines.ROUTER_SYMMETRIC: the historical methodology refitted on symmetric DEV (the stage router)
baselines.PERFECT_POLICY_SELECTOR: oracle reference: minimum-regret proposing headline policy

diagnostics.REGIME_GATED_SWITCH: predeclared diagnostic of the central hypothesis: if the DEV-fitted COSTLY_ACTION_OPTIMAL predictor exceeds its CAL threshold, select NEXUS V1 when it proposes (else THREAT, else OBJECTIVE, else RESOURCE); otherwise RESOURCE. Linear, untrained beyond the regime predictor.
diagnostics.COSTLY_ORACLE_SWITCH: oracle reference for the gate: the same switch driven by the TRUE costly label (upper bound of the gated approach)

downstream: NORMALIZED_REGRET (regret / max regret of the episode surface)
CATASTROPHIC_ERROR_RATE (raw regret >= 100, Stage 3F.6 contract; raw-scale caveat)
POLICY_SELECTION_ACCURACY (selected policy in the best set)
relative: ROUTER_MINUS_RESOURCE / BEST_SINGLE / CASCADE: accuracy, regret, normalized regret, paired bootstrap 95%
metrics.headroom: HEADROOM_AVAILABLE = perfect selector minus best single; HEADROOM_CAPTURED_ACCURACY = (router - best single) / (oracle - best single); HEADROOM_CAPTURED_REGRET likewise when the denominator > 0
metrics.collapse: selection distribution per partition; historical rule: POLICY_COLLAPSE when the top share > 0.9 and exceeds that policy's best-set share by > 0.05
metrics.specialistValue: for each specialist the router selects instead of RESOURCE: BENEFIT_SAVED = sum over such episodes of max(0, r_RESOURCE - r_S), FALSE_SELECTION_HARM = sum of max(0, r_S - r_RESOURCE), both per partition episode (raw and normalized); NET = benefit - harm
metrics.historicalHarm: historical rule: acceptable when episodes worsened <= improved AND false-selection p95 added regret <= best single p95 regret
metrics.bootstrap: accuracy and raw regret: the historical pairedBootstrap (1000 resamples, seed 3647); normalized regret: 1000 paired resamples, mulberry32 seeded by sha256(label)
metrics.latency: wall-clock scoring latency is measured and reported in the console and documentation only; it is not deterministic and is excluded from the certificate hash

historical.rule: accuracy gain >= 0.02 with CI lower > 0, OR raw regret reduction >= 2.0 with CI upper < 0

correctionsDeclaredBeforeSealedEvaluatio: ACCURACY_WORSE case added: the historical Stage 3F.6-T documented that its rules lacked an accuracy-only "worse" outcome; here accuracy CI upper < 0 is ROUTER_WORSE

SCALE: the raw regret bar (2.0) was calibrated where always-RESOURCE mean regret was ~26; on the symmetric corpus it is ~52 (HOLDOUT) and ~84 (OOD), halving the bar in relative terms. The headline regret criterion is therefore normalized: mean normalized-regret reduction >= 0.02 with CI upper < 0. The historical raw rule is still reported.
materiality.headline: MATERIAL = (accuracy gain >= 0.02 AND CI lower > 0 AND normalized regret not significantly worse) OR (normalized-regret reduction >= 0.02 AND CI upper < 0 AND accuracy not significantly worse)
materiality.mixedTradeoff: MIXED_ACCURACY_REGRET_TRADEOFF when one metric is significantly better and the other significantly worse; never MATERIAL, never statistically better
materiality.mixedGuardDisclosure: the mixed-tradeoff guard was added after the open phase showed, on CAL only, that the historical methodology trades accuracy for regret (CAL: regret 44.6 -> 39.8, accuracy 0.261 -> 0.204); it only makes the bar stricter
materiality.oodNotWorse: on FRESH_OOD the router is not significantly worse than the best single on accuracy (CI upper >= 0) nor on normalized regret (CI lower <= 0)

primaryPrecedence: ROUTER_VALUE_CONFIRMED if MATERIAL vs best single AND MATERIAL vs FIXED_PRIORITY_CASCADE_HEADLINE on FRESH_HOLDOUT AND oodNotWorse AND no collapse AND historical harm acceptable
ROUTER_COLLAPSES_TO_SINGLE_POLICY if POLICY_COLLAPSE on FRESH_HOLDOUT and not MATERIAL vs best single
ROUTER_VALUE_SMALL if statistically better than best single (one metric significantly better, the other not significantly worse) but not CONFIRMED
DEPLOYABLE_FEATURES_INSUFFICIENT if COSTLY_ACTION_OPTIMAL and NEXUS_V1_BEATS_RESOURCE are both NOT_IDENTIFIABLE on FRESH_HOLDOUT
EXPERT_COMPLEMENTARITY_NOT_ROUTABLE if the FRESH_HOLDOUT accuracy headroom lower bound >= 0.05 but HEADROOM_CAPTURED_ACCURACY < 0.2
conclusions.secondary: every label whose own condition holds is also listed, plus MIXED_ACCURACY_REGRET_TRADEOFF when it holds vs the best single on FRESH_HOLDOUT

roadmap.ROUTER_VALUE_MATERIAL: MATERIAL vs best single on FRESH_HOLDOUT and oodNotWorse
roadmap.ROUTER_2_0_JUSTIFIED: primary conclusion ROUTER_VALUE_CONFIRMED (complementarity exists, deployable features identify it, material downstream value beyond the untrained cascade)
roadmap.EXPERT_REPAIR_REQUIRED: not ROUTER_2_0_JUSTIFIED, or perfect-selector accuracy on FRESH_HOLDOUT < 0.5

amendments.timing: after the open phase (DEV/CAL only) and before any fresh confirmatory row existed or any router result on a HOLDOUT or OOD partition was computed
amendments.reason: the stage brief requires roadmap fields and reports the first freeze did not define; defining them now avoids choosing them after sealed evaluation
unchanged: router methodology, threshold grid and CAL rule
regime targets, model and identifiability bars

additions.EXPERT_COMPLEMENTARITY_EXISTS: FRESH_HOLDOUT accuracy headroom (perfect selector minus best single) has 95% CI lower bound >= 0.05, the bar already used by EXPERT_COMPLEMENTARITY_NOT_ROUTABLE
additions.POLICY_QUALITY_REMAINS_PRIMARY_BOTTLENEC: on FRESH_HOLDOUT the accuracy lost to the policy set (1 - perfect selector accuracy) exceeds the accuracy lost to selection (perfect selector accuracy - max(router, best single) accuracy)
additions.SELECTION_DISTRIBUTION_DEV_CAL: router selection distribution and routed (non-abstained) share on DEV and CAL are recorded in the open-phase report, so the collapse audit covers DEV, CAL, HOLDOUT and OOD
additions.REGIME_METRICS_DEV_CAL: regime predictor metrics are also reported on DEV (in-sample, fit partition) and CAL (selection partition) in the open-phase report
additions.SPECIALIST_VALUE_DETAIL: per specialist: correct selections (selected policy in the best set) and false selections (not in the best set), plus the benefit/harm accounting stratified by the oracle COSTLY_ACTION_OPTIMAL label (stratification for reporting only; never a router input)
additions.POLICY_BY_REGIME: accuracy, mean regret and mean normalized regret of every headline policy and of the router on costly-optimal and free-optimal rows (descriptive)
additions.GENERATION_PROVENANCE: the fresh manifest records the HEAD commit at generation; certification requires that commit to contain this amendment and the plan, open report, generator, certifier and router-value module to be byte-identical between that commit and certification

featureSet.source: identical to the historical Stage 3F.6-T router input (sorted DEPLOYABLE_CORE ids); nothing added, removed or replaced
